steps.title: Counting dots
steps.hint: Touch each dot once and say one number for each.
steps.explanation: Count each dot once: there are 9.
steps.shortExplanation: Count each dot once: there are 9.

steps.title: Take away 3
steps.hint: Start on 7 and jump back three times.
steps.explanation: Taking three away from seven leaves four.
steps.shortExplanation: Taking three away from seven leaves four.

steps.title: Three sides
steps.prompt: Name a flat shape with 3 sides.
steps.hint: Count the straight sides of each shape.
steps.explanation: A triangle has three straight sides.
steps.shortExplanation: A triangle has three straight sides.

steps.title: Like a football
steps.prompt: Name a solid shape like a football.
steps.hint: Is a football flat or solid? Round or with edges?
steps.explanation: A football is solid and round like a sphere.
steps.shortExplanation: A football is solid and round like a sphere.

steps.title: The longest row
steps.prompt: The longest pictogram row shows the...
steps.hint: More pictures make a longer row.
steps.explanation: The longest row has the most equal-size pictures.
steps.shortExplanation: The longest row has the most equal-size pictures.

steps.title: The larger number
steps.hint: Which number comes later when you count?
steps.explanation: 18 comes after 15 on the number track.
steps.shortExplanation: 18 comes after 15 on the number track.

steps.title: An empty bag
steps.prompt: How many sweets are in an empty bag?
steps.hint: Empty means there is nothing inside.
steps.explanation: An empty bag contains zero sweets.
steps.shortExplanation: An empty bag contains zero sweets.

steps.title: Sleep time
steps.hint: Is it light or dark when you go to bed?

steps.title: Comparing pencils
steps.prompt: What should you line up to compare two pencils?
steps.explanation: Start both pencils at the same line.
steps.shortExplanation: Start both pencils at the same line.

source.answerKeyText: the ends (on the same starting line)

stickers.meaning: Start with a number and add forward jumps.

homeActivities.text: Revisit the home games for this term. Talk about how each answer was found.
homeActivities.textAr: ارجعوا العبوا ألعاب البيت بتاعة الترم ده تاني، واتكلموا عن كل إجابة: وصلنالها إزاي؟
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Draw 9 dots on paper. Your child counts them and crosses out each dot once, so none is counted twice.
goalActivities.textAr: ارسموا ٩ نقط على ورقة. طفلك يعدّهم ويشطب كل نقطة مرة واحدة، عشان مايعدّش نقطة مرتين.

parentNote.en: Drawing and personal answers are discussed with an adult and are not automatically graded. Estimate first; a guess is not a scored answer.
parentNote.ar: الرسم والإجابات الشخصية بنتناقش فيها مع شخص كبير ومش بنقيّمها تلقائيًا. التوقع الأول مش إجابة عليها درجات.
